stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Jason Thomson climbed 19 places - the handicapper calls it an anomaly, the bar calls it form

stories.title: Away-Day Raid
stories.detail: Visitor from Tumut GC sitting 1st - raiding the local silverware

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: From everyone at Wagga Wagga Country Club, welcome Jaden Newbigging of Wagga City GC. Have a great round.

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +5 on hole 9 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 9 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Led most of the day, run down to 5th at the death

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Andrew Powell down to 11th from 1st - the run home turned into a run away

stories.title: Wooden Spoon Watch
stories.detail: Joanne Flanagan at the tail - Wests Tigers avoided the spoon this year, so anything is possible
